native-nordschleife-1807-{context,view,pose}.bin

Source: camera-rejection.json of the VR Practice session 20261112-004120-418
(GRID2VR test build, converted Nordschleife custom track, Meta Quest 3 via
VirtualDesktopXR), frame 1807, second eye. The bytes are the renderer's own
receipt of the camera context (512 bytes), scene view (144 bytes) and eye pose
(orientation x,y,z,w then position x,y,z, 28 bytes), unmodified.

The scene view and the native inverted camera place the start-line camera at
z=4779.58740234375 and z=4779.5859375: three float ULPs apart. The former
two-ULP allowance refused the eye pose, which suspended stereo and, on resume,
failed the session (eye_previous_camera_or_history).
